sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS COASTAL NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... PROMINENT/EXTENSIVE WEST-EAST UPPER RIDGE WILL REMAIN CENTERED OVER THE SOUTHERN PLAINS THROUGH THE PERIOD. ON THE PERIPHERY OF THIS UPPER RIDGE...RELATIVELY LOW AMPLITUDE/PROGRESSIVE WESTERLIES WILL PREVAIL OVER THE NORTHERN TIER AND PORTIONS OF THE WEST/EAST COASTS...INCLUDING A SOUTHEASTWARD DIGGING UPPER LOW OVER NEW ENGLAND.

sections.title: GREAT LAKES REGION
sections.text: CURRENT SHORT-TERM INDICATIONS ARE THAT A POTENTIALLY SEVERE MCS WILL BE ONGOING ACROSS PORTIONS OF NORTHERN WI/UPPER MI AND THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION EARLY THIS MORNING. THE SPECIFIC EVOLUTION OF THIS MCS/EARLY DAY STORMS IS A BIT UNCERTAIN...BUT MESOSCALE PROCESSES /COLD POOL AND POTENTIAL MCV/ ALONG WITH A SUSTAINED/VEERING LOW LEVEL JET COULD HELP MAINTAIN A QUASI-LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM SOUTHEASTWARD DURING THE DAY TOWARD LAKE MI/LOWER MI AND EVENTUALLY THE LOWER GREAT LAKES VICINITY. REGARDLESS...OTHER SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT SEEMS PROBABLE DURING THE AFTERNOON AS A MOIST INFLUX/INSTABILITY FEED PERSISTS FROM THE WEST-SOUTHWEST...MAINLY ALONG THE SOUTHEASTWARD MOVING COLD FRONT AND/OR ON THE SOUTHWEST PERIPHERY OF THE EARLY DAY MCS/ASSOCIATED CLOUD COVER. THIS WOULD MOST LIKELY OCCUR IN THE LAKE MI GENERAL VICINITY INCLUDING PORTIONS OF WI AND NORTHERN IL/INDIANA AND PERHAPS LOWER MI/NORTHERN OH PENDING THE EARLY DAY MCS. OVERALL...WITH POTENTIAL FOR THE DEVELOPMENT/SUSTENANCE OF ONE OR MORE SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING TSTM CLUSTERS/POTENTIAL MCS/S...DAMAGING WINDS AND TO A LESSER EXTENT SEVERE HAIL ARE EXPECTED TO BE THE PRIMARY CONCERNS.

sections.title: NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: AS THE AFOREMENTIONED CLOSED UPPER LOW SPREADS SOUTHEASTWARD OVER NEW ENGLAND TODAY...RELATIVELY LOW-TOPPED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON MAINLY ACROSS COASTAL NEW ENGLAND IN VICINITY OF A SURFACE TROUGH AND/OR A SOUTHEASTWARD-SWEEPING COLD FRONT. WHILE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE MODEST ASIDE FROM WESTERN/SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND...SUFFICIENT LOW LEVEL HEATING IN CONJUNCTION WITH RELATIVELY COOL THERMAL PROFILES ALOFT /-12 TO -16C AT 500 MB/ AND ASSOCIATED STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/POTENTIALLY COPIOUS SUB-SEVERE HAIL...AND PERHAPS DAMAGING WINDS AS WELL.

sections.title: SOUTHERN ROCKIES TO CENTRAL PLAINS/MIDDLE MO VALLEY
sections.text: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED TSTMS WILL BE POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS/MIDDLE MO VALLEY IN VICINITY OF THE SOUTHEAST-MOVING COLD FRONT. ADDITIONALLY...AIDED BY SEVERAL LOW AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCES PIVOTING AROUND THE SOUTHERN PLAINS-CENTERED UPPER RIDGE...A RELATIVELY HIGH PW ENVIRONMENT WILL ALSO SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS ACROSS THE SOUTHERN ROCKIES/FOUR CORNERS VICINITY. OVERALL...DOWNBURSTS CAPABLE OF LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE AND SOME HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY CONCERNS MAINLY LATE THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: NORTHERN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION
sections.text: POTENTIALLY AIDED BY A FEW MID-LEVEL DISTURBANCES CROSSING THE REGION...A FAVORABLE COLOCATION OF MODERATE CYCLONIC FLOW ALOFT/ADEQUATE PW WILL LIKELY YIELD SOME TSTMS CAPABLE OF SEVERE WIND/HAIL ON AN ISOLATED BASIS THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: GULF COAST REGION
sections.text: IN SPITE OF WARM TEMPERATURES/POOR LAPSE RATES ALOFT...A MOIST/HOT BOUNDARY LAYER MAY YIELD SOME STRONGER STORMS WITH WET MICROBURSTS CAPABLE OF LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE. ..GUYER/ROGERS.. 08/02/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: BROAD ANTICYCLONE WILL REMAIN ANCHORED OVER THE SRN PLNS/OZARKS THIS PERIOD. A LOW AMPLITUDE EXTENSION OF THE ANTICYCLONE SHOULD BUILD N ACROSS THE NRN PLNS IN WAKE OF UPR IMPULSE NOW OVER THE UPR MS VLY. THE LATTER FEATURE WILL MOVE E ACROSS THE UPR GRT LKS THIS AFTN...BEFORE SHEARING SEWD IN SEASONABLY STRONG NW FLOW ACROSS THE LWR GRT LKS/NRN APPALACHIANS EARLY WED. ELSEWHERE...SRN QUEBEC UPR LOW EXPECTED TO DRIFT SLOWLY SE ACROSS ME...WHILE AN IMPULSE IN BELT OF ENHANCED FLOW ON NW FRINGE OF THE PLNS RIDGE MOVES NEWD FROM CA/NV TO THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION. A WEAK COLD FRONT WILL MOVE SE ACROSS THE UPR MS VLY...UPR GRT LKS...AND CNTRL PLNS TODAY IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE UPR MS VLY UPR IMPULSE. A WEAK COLD FRONT ALSO WILL MOVE SE ACROSS NEW ENGLAND.

sections.title: UPR-MID MS VLY TO GRT LKS TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: LOOSELY ORGANIZED N CNTRL WI MCS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE ESE ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL/SRN WI THROUGH LATER THIS MORNING...WITH SOME INTENSIFICATION POSSIBLE ON SRN SIDE AS SFC HEATING DESTABILIZES INFLOW. SUFFICIENT DEEP SHEAR APPEARS PRESENT TO SUPPORT EMBEDDED SUSTAINED STRUCTURES AND CIRCULATIONS THAT COULD POSE A CONTINUED RISK FOR DMGG WIND GIVEN MOISTURE-RICH ENVIRONMENT /PW AROUND 2 INCHES/. UPSTREAM SMALL CONVECTIVE SYSTEM IN MN...NOW W OF STC...SHOULD MOVE GENERALLY EWD. THIS SYSTEM ULTIMATELY MAY MERGE WITH BACK-BUILDING STORMS ON W SIDE OF WI COMPLEX. DESPITE BEING SLIGHTLY ELEVATED ATOP SHALLOW OUTFLOW LEFT BY EARLIER STORMS...DAYTIME HEATING...HIGH PW VALUES...AND STRENGTH OF WIND FIELD ALSO SUGGEST A THREAT FOR AT LEAST SPORADIC DMGG WIND AND POSSIBLY MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. THIS AFTN...ADDITIONAL STORMS SHOULD FORM OVER PARTS OF SRN WI...SE MN...AND NRN/ERN IA...ON THE SRN/WRN PERIPHERIES OF OUTFLOW FROM THE MORNING SYSTEMS...AND ALONG COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH UPR MS VLY UPR IMPULSE. AT THE SAME TIME...SEWD-PROPAGATING SEGMENTS OF THE MORNING MCSS MAY REACH PARTS OF LWR MI AND NRN IL. BY EARLY EVE...SEVERAL COMPLEX CLUSTERS OF STORMS LIKELY WILL HAVE EVOLVED...EACH OF WHICH

sections.title: SRN/ERN NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTN
sections.text: SCTD LOW-TOPPED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED OVER SRN/ERN NEW ENGLAND TODAY IN ZONE OF ASCENT AHEAD OF APPROACHING UPR LOW. ACTIVITY SHOULD BE FOCUSED ALONG N/S SFC TROUGH AND/OR WEAK SE-MOVING COLD FRONT. WHILE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE FAIRLY MODEST...COMBINATION OF STRONG SFC HEATING WITH COOL MID LVL TEMPS /-12 TO -16C AT 500 MB/ WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR HAIL...SOME OF WHICH COULD REACH SVR LIMITS. A FEW STORMS COULD PRODUCE LOCALLY DMGG WIND.

sections.title: SRN RCKYS TO CNTRL PLNS/MID MO VLY THIS AFTN/EARLY TNGT
sections.text: ISOLD TO SCTD TSTMS SHOULD FORM MAINLY THIS AFTN THROUGH EARLY TNGT ALONG COLD FRONT CROSSING THE CNTRL PLNS/MID MO VLY. OTHER STORMS MAY FORM OVER THE SRN RCKYS/FOUR CORNERS REGION IN ASSOCIATION WITH LOW AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCES MOVING AROUND PLNS UPR HIGH. ISOLD DOWNBURSTS WITH LOCALLY DMGG WIND AND PERHAPS HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE GIVEN RELATIVELY HIGH PW VALUES AND STEEP LOW LVL LAPSE RATES.

sections.title: NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION THIS AFTN/EARLY TNGT
sections.text: ASCENT PROVIDED BY CA/NV UPR IMPULSE AND FAVORABLE CO-LOCATION OF MODERATE CYCLONIC MID/UPR LVL FLOW WITH ADEQUATE PW MAY YIELD SCTD TSTMS CAPABLE OF SVR WIND/HAIL FROM NRN NV/NRN UT INTO PARTS OF ID AND WRN/CNTRL MT THIS AFTN THROUGH EARLY TNGT.

sections.title: GULF CST REGION THIS AFTN
sections.text: IN SPITE OF WARM TEMPERATURES/WEAK MID LVL LAPSE RATES...HEATING OF VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER MAY YIELD ISOLD STORMS WITH WET MICROBURSTS. ..CORFIDI/COHEN.. 08/02/2011

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY/UPPER MIDWEST ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES
sections.text: A COUPLE OF NOCTURNAL MCSS ARE ONGOING ACROSS WI...AIDED BY ENHANCED INFLOW AT THE TERMINUS OF A 30-40 KT LLJ...AND FORCING ATTENDANT TO MCV NEAR MSP. THIS ACTIVITY MAY UNDERGO SOME DIURNAL WEAKENING LATE THIS MORNING/EARLY AFTERNOON BEFORE REFORMING AND/OR RE-INTENSIFYING FARTHER S/SW ALONG TRAILING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND COLD FRONT APPROACHING FROM THE W. WARM SECTOR AIR MASS IS EXPECTED TO BECOME STRONGLY TO EXTREMELY UNSTABLE BY AFTERNOON /I.E. MLCAPE OF 3000-4000 J PER KG/ OWING TO THE PRESENCE OF A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND STRONG DAYTIME HEATING S OF CONVECTIVE CIRRUS CANOPY. WHEN COUPLED WITH 30-40 KT OF DEEP NWLY SHEAR...SETUP WILL FAVOR ORGANIZED STORM MODES...INCLUDING SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STRUCTURES...WITH THE PRIMARY HAZARDS BEING DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A SEWD-MOVING MCS IS ANTICIPATED WITH A CONTINUED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL SPREADING INTO THE OH VALLEY TONIGHT.

sections.title: ERN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THIS AFTERNOON IN ADVANCE OF MIDLEVEL VORTICITY MAXIMUM TRANSLATING SEWD THROUGH VT/NH. 12Z GYX/CHH SOUNDINGS SAMPLED THE PRESENCE OF MODERATE ELEVATED INSTABILITY WITH MUCAPE OF 1500-2000 J/KG. DAYTIME HEATING COMBINED WITH MIDLEVEL COOLING ATTENDANT TO VORTICITY MAXIMUM SHOULD SUPPORT AN INCREASE IN SURFACE-BASED POTENTIAL INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 1000-1500 J/KG BY LATE AFTERNOON. NRN EXTENT OF SLIGHT RISK AREA WILL LIKELY EXPERIENCE MORE DISORGANIZED STORM MODES WITH HAIL BEING THE PRIMARY HAZARD. FARTHER S...THE PRESENCE OF 50+ KT MIDLEVEL JET STREAK ROUNDING LARGE-SCALE UPPER-LOW WILL RESULT IN SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STRUCTURES WITH RISKS FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: MID/LOWER MO VALLEY INTO CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: AN INCREASE IN DIURNAL STORMS IS EXPECTED TODAY ALONG COLD FRONT WITHIN A THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY STEEP LAPSE RATES AND MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-3000 J/KG. WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR WILL LIMIT STORM ORGANIZATION...THOUGH LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MOST INTENSE STORMS. ..MEAD/GARNER.. 08/02/2011

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY INTO GREAT LAKES
sections.text: THE AIR MASS CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE OVER SERN MN/NRN IA/SRN WI...WHERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS. FORECAST APPEARS ON TRACK WITH STORMS GROWING UPSCALE AND SURGING SOUTHEASTWARD INTO PARTS OF LWR MI/IL/IND DURING THE EVENING. DAMAGING WINDS APPEAR TO BE THE MAIN THREAT. HOWEVER...SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR IS PRESENT FOR A RISK OF SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO.

sections.title: NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: THE INITIAL BAND OF INTENSE STORMS HAS MOVED OFF THE ME COAST...AHEAD OF MID/UPPER LOW MOVING INTO AREA. RESIDUAL STORMS BENEATH UPPER COLD POOL WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A RISK OF HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS...BUT THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO HAVE PASSED. ..HART.. 08/02/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1112 AM CDT TUE AUG 02 2011/

sections.text: FED BY A VERY MOIST/UNSTABLE AIRMASS AS PER THE DAVENPORT 00Z OBSERVED SOUNDING /6800 J PER KG MLCAPE/...ONGOING QUASI-LINEAR MCS NEAR SOUTHERN LOWER MI EARLY THIS EVENING MAY EXPAND/FURTHER ACCELERATE AS IT SPREADS SOUTHEASTWARD TONIGHT INTO SOUTHERN LOWER MI AND OH/INDIANA. OTHER MCS-PERIPHERAL DEVELOPMENT...AT LEAST ON AN ISOLATED BASIS...SEEMS LIKELY TO OCCUR ALONG THE SURFACE BOUNDARY THAT EXTENDS WESTWARD INTO NORTHERN IL...WITH OTHER STORMS PRECEDING THE MCS VIA WARM ADVECTION. OVERALL...DAMAGING WINDS ARE EXPECTED TO THE PRIMARY THREAT...WITH LARGE HAIL A POSSIBILITY AS WELL WITH ANY SUPERCELLS/MORE DISCRETE STORMS GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY. ALSO REFERENCE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1836 FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION. ..GUYER.. 08/03/2011
